items.message: High tides, strong winds and large waves today may lead to flooding.  Flooding is possible from 11:30 to 21:30 on Tuesday 17th November.  Locations most affected will be coastal roads, footpaths, promenades and other exposed locations along the North Sea coast from Whitby to Filey, including Scarborough. The risk of flooding should reduce once the tide has passed.  We are closely monitoring the situation .  Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water.   This message will be updated by 9:00AM on Wednesday 18 November or as the situation changes.

Flooding is forecast to affect locations near the Bristol Avon, Tetbury Avon, Sherston Avon, Dauntsey Brook, with low lying land and roads expected to be most affected, particularly around low lying areas in Tetbury, Badminton, Brook End at Luckington, Corsham, Lacock and the road at Reybridge				
Flooding is still possible based on the rainfall from Monday night, combined with the forecast rainfall overnight Tuesday night and into Wednesday. River levels are forecast to rise again overnight.

Higher than normal tides tomorrow morning may lead to flooding.
Flooding is possible from 04:00AM to 08:00AM on 18/11/26.
The highest tide level is expected to be at Christchurch Harbour and tidal stretches of the Lower Stour and Avon at 06:00AM on 18/11/2026 with a level of 1.22 mAODN and a Westerly force 6 wind. Our threshold for issuing the Flood Alert for Christchurch Harbour is 1.20 mAODN so we anticipate only a small rise above this level.
We are closely monitoring the situation Start acting on your flood plan if you have one.
Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water. Avoid coastal roads and low lying roads near rivers, which may be flooded.
This message will be updated by 2:00PM on Wednesday 18 November or as the situation changes.
